components.name: Screen background
components.notes: Reference canvas is 853 × 1843 px; logical width is 412 dp. Convert all image measurements to dp or sp by multiplying by 412/853 = 0.4830. Background is very pale lavender with subtle soft variation. Sampled colors and geometry are visual estimates.

components.name: Android status bar
components.notes: Transparent background; dark icons. Time at approximately x48 y24; connectivity, battery, and percentage occupy x630–802. Match OS status-bar insets rather than rendering these as application content.

components.name: Device connection app bar
components.notes: Transparent container. Custom two-line title content, leading display icon, dropdown chevron after device name, and trailing overflow action. Standard Material app-bar default dimensions require adjustment to match this reference.

components.name: Connected-device display icon
components.notes: Outlined television icon; visible artwork approximately x45 y104, 55 × 42 px. Dark purple stroke approximately 4 px.

components.name: Device title
components.notes: Single-line text: Living Room · Mi Box S. Baseline approximately y115.

components.name: Device dropdown chevron
components.notes: Down chevron with approximately 3 px stroke. Device title and chevron share the device-selector click target.

components.name: Connected status
components.notes: Wi-Fi icon at x151 y134, approximately 27 × 22 px; Connected text starts at x191. Full component includes icon and status text.

components.name: More options
components.notes: Icon-only overflow action with three vertical dark dots. Visible artwork approximately x796–804, y106–137. Use an IconButton implementation with a minimum 48 dp interaction target.

components.name: Current media summary
components.notes: Horizontal media row containing YouTube artwork, title, elapsed/total time, and a thin seek-progress line beneath the text.

components.name: Current media YouTube logo
components.notes: Red rounded YouTube badge with white play triangle. Preserve the branded silhouette using a vector asset.

components.name: Current media title
components.notes: Single-line text: Me at the zoo.

components.name: Playback time
components.notes: One text block: 0:12 / 0:19. Elapsed time is purple; slash and total are muted lavender.

components.name: Playback progress
components.notes: Rounded 7 px track; active segment approximately 432 px, ending at x559. Progress is approximately 63%. No thumb or stop marker.

components.name: Remote input mode selector
components.notes: Four icon-and-label segments in one pale lavender pill. D-pad selected. Remove standard outlined borders and checkmark; selected segment is a solid purple pill. Content order: D-pad, Swipe, Mouse, Numpad.

components.name: D-pad mode segment
components.notes: White four-direction icon at approximately x77 y317, 39 × 40 px; label at x134 y324. Entire segment is selected.

components.name: Swipe mode segment
components.notes: Outlined gesture-hand icon at approximately x277 y318, 32 × 39 px; label begins x331.

components.name: Mouse mode segment
components.notes: Outlined mouse icon at approximately x469 y318, 26 × 39 px; label begins x518.

components.name: Numpad mode segment
components.notes: Nine-dot icon at approximately x647 y322, 32 × 32 px; label begins x699.

components.name: Circular directional pad
components.notes: 480 px diameter, approximately 232 dp. Center at approximately (427, 658). Pale lavender fill, 1–1.5 px outline, four diagonal separators, and a central circular OK button. Use Canvas or custom-shaped clickable regions; clip every region to the disk. Outer stroke and separators are faint lavender.

components.name: D-pad up region
components.notes: Upper annular sector; bbox describes the entire curved sector, not just its chevron. Chevron artwork approximately x406–447, y494–516.

components.name: D-pad right region
components.notes: Right annular sector. Chevron artwork approximately x575–596, y638–678.

components.name: D-pad down region
components.notes: Lower annular sector. Chevron artwork approximately x406–447, y800–822.

components.name: D-pad left region
components.notes: Left annular sector. Chevron artwork approximately x257–278, y638–678.

components.name: D-pad OK button
components.notes: Circular button with slightly stronger lavender fill and a thin lavender border. Centered OK label. No elevation.

components.name: Back action
components.notes: Whole component includes 110 × 110 px circular icon button and Back label below. Circle at x127 y922; arrow artwork approximately x165 y960, 37 × 35 px. Text centered around x182.

components.name: Home action
components.notes: Whole component includes 110 × 110 px circle and Home label. House icon approximately x408 y959, 38 × 39 px.

components.name: Settings action
components.notes: Whole component includes 110 × 110 px circle and Settings label. Thin circle outline; gear artwork approximately x650 y957, 42 × 42 px.

components.name: Volume control group
components.notes: Large filled lavender capsule containing separate minus and plus tonal buttons and centered Volume 12 text. This is a stepper, with no visible slider track.

components.name: Decrease volume
components.notes: Circular inset button. Minus artwork approximately x135–166, y1159–1163.

components.name: Volume value
components.notes: Single centered text block: Volume 12.

components.name: Increase volume
components.notes: Circular inset button. Plus artwork approximately x527–562, y1143–1179.

components.name: Mute action
components.notes: Whole component includes 111 × 111 px circular icon button and Mute label. Slashed-speaker icon approximately x689 y1138, 47 × 43 px.

components.name: Previous / rewind
components.notes: Circular button. Filled double-left-triangle artwork approximately x212 y1291, 46 × 29 px.

components.name: Pause playback
components.notes: Circular button, larger than adjacent transport buttons. Two filled dark pause bars approximately x412 y1286 through x442 y1325.

components.name: Next / fast forward
components.notes: Circular button. Filled double-right-triangle artwork approximately x596 y1291, 46 × 29 px.

components.name: Favourite apps header row
components.notes: Section title left-aligned with screen margin; Edit text action aligned to x813 at the right.

components.name: Favourite apps title
components.notes: Single-line section title: Favourite apps.

components.name: Edit favourite apps
components.notes: Purple Edit label; visible glyphs approximately x771 y1392. Expand interaction target to 48 dp without shifting the artwork.

components.name: Favourite apps horizontal carousel
components.notes: Compose LazyRow with 24 px item spacing. Each full item is approximately 146–148 px wide. Viewport clips the right side of VLC at x813, retaining the 40 px right page gutter.

components.name: YouTube favourite app
components.notes: Whole item includes a 146 × 109 px outlined logo tile and YouTube label below. Tile corners approximately 26 px. Red logo artwork approximately x79 y1457, 68 × 47 px. Label centered below tile.

components.name: Netflix favourite app
components.notes: Whole item includes a 148 × 109 px tile and Netflix label. Red N artwork approximately x266 y1450, 37 × 64 px.

components.name: Hoichoi favourite app
components.notes: Whole item includes a 148 × 109 px tile and Hoichoi label. Red h artwork approximately x439 y1450, 35 × 63 px.

components.name: Toffee favourite app
components.notes: Whole item includes a 148 × 109 px tile and Toffee label. Magenta logo artwork approximately x589 y1457, 72 × 51 px.

components.name: VLC favourite app, visible portion
components.notes: BBox covers the entire visible clipped component, including the visible tile and VLC label. Logical item width is approximately 148 px, extending to x872; carousel viewport ends at x813. Orange cone asset is also clipped by that viewport.

components.name: Bottom action separator
components.notes: Single faint lavender horizontal divider. Use HorizontalDivider.

components.name: Keyboard action
components.notes: Whole component includes a 112 × 112 px circular button and Keyboard label. Keyboard icon approximately x207 y1669, 43 × 30 px.

components.name: Voice action
components.notes: Custom circular 135 × 135 px purple button with Voice label below. White microphone icon approximately x407 y1656, 40 × 54 px. Remove FAB elevation and override default shape and size; this is the most prominent bottom action.

components.name: Power action
components.notes: Whole component includes a 111 × 112 px circle and Power label. Power icon approximately x605 y1663, 44 × 46 px. Bottom actions are commands, so do not implement them as navigation destinations.

components.name: System gesture navigation area
components.notes: Transparent system navigation area. Visible rounded gesture handle approximately x334 y1817, 185 × 8 px, muted lavender.
